name: DiceyTable
summary:
Your table. Your games. Your rules.

Welcome to DiceyTable, a 3D tabletop gaming playground where new and classic games come to life, competition gets fierce, and your imagination sets the limits! Roll realistic dice, shuffle and deal cards, and move pieces across a fully interactive, physics-driven tabletop—all directly in your browser, with nothing to download or install.

Challenge your friends, take on AI opponents with adjustable difficulty, or battle your way up the leaderboards in ranked multiplayer matches. Discover a growing collection of classic board and card games, some featuring fully scripted rules and automated gameplay, while others simply let you experince the freedom of a traditional tabletop. Gather up to ten players around a table, keep your cards hidden with private hands, and even step into the action with VR support.

Why just play games when you can create them? Unleash your creativity with DiceyTable's built-in game editor, where you can design, customize, and share your own tabletop experiences with players everywhere.

Whether you're a casual player, a fierce competitor, or an aspiring game creator, there's always a seat waiting for you at DiceyTable.
